FX-BENDER-001.says: The settings as they start: Amount 20, Bend, the axis from the middle of the bottom edge to the middle of the top. Each row is pushed right by 20 times the square of its height up the drawing, so the bottom rows barely move and the top ones are pushed clean off the drawing: a hard bend.

FX-BENDER-003.says: Bend, Amount 4: row 1, the stripes' top row, pushed 2.89 pixels right, the band's rows 1.21 and 0.81, and row 8 0.09: the stripes curve over to the right.

FX-BENDER-004.says: Bend, Amount -4: the same push to the left.

FX-BENDER-005.says: Marilyn, Amount 4: the middle rows swell 4 pixels right and the top and bottom rows hardly move, a smooth bulge.

FX-BENDER-006.says: Sharp, Amount 4: the same swell as a triangle, its point in the middle.

FX-BENDER-007.says: Boxer, Amount 4: a smooth S from the bottom row to the top, the top pushed most nearly 4 pixels.

FX-BENDER-008.says: Adjust To Distance on, Amount 40: 40 per cent of the 10-pixel axis, 4 pixels: FX-BENDER-003 exactly.

FX-BENDER-009.says: Bend, Amount 2, the axis from row 7 up to row 3: rows 7 to 9 below the Base stay put, the rows to the Top curve, and the rows past it, 1 and 2, carry on straight, slanting further, 2 (2 s - 1) pixels.

FX-BENDER-010.says: Marilyn, Amount 2, the same short axis: only rows 3 to 6 swell; the rest is untouched.

FX-BENDER-011.says: Boxer, Amount 3, the axis lying across from the middle of the left edge to the middle of the right: n points down, so the columns are pushed down, the right ones 3 pixels.

FX-BENDER-012.says: Top and Base the same point: no axis, the drawing untouched.

FX-BENDER-013.says: Amount keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 8 at frame 4, linear: frame 0 the drawing, frame 2 FX-BENDER-003.

FX-BENDER-014.says: Bend, Amount 3, the Top keyed from 50, 0 at frame 0 to 50, 50 at frame 4: the axis shortens and the same push bends harder.

FX-BENDER-015.says: FX-BENDER-005 moved three pixels right: the same, moved; nothing grows, and the three columns left of the drawing stay empty.

FX-BENDER-016.says: Sharp, Amount 0.5: half a pixel at most, a blend of neighbouring stripes rather than a move.

FX-BENDER-017.says: Amount eased from 0 at frame 0 to 1000 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass 1000 and is held there.

FX-BENDER-018.says: Amount 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BENDER-019.says: Amount -1001, below -1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BENDER-020.says: A style written "Bend", with a capital. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BENDER-021.says: Adjust To Distance written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BENDER-022.says: Top 50, 1001, past ten heights. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-BENDER-023.says: Amount keyed to 2000 at frame 4. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
